items.name: iPhone 14 · 128 GB · unlocked · Renewed Excellent
items.notes: Midnight; Bontend Company offer. Advertised battery minimum 80%; 90-day returns. Inspect display, battery and port on arrival.

items.name: CanaKit Raspberry Pi 5 PRO · 4 GB / 128 GB
items.notes: Includes 45 W supply with 5 V/5 A profile, cooling, case, card and reader. Do not buy those accessories again.

items.name: EMEET C960 4K · autofocus · USB-A
items.notes: UVC; built-in 1.5 m cable and 1/4-inch mount. Initial mounting distance 25–35 cm. Quoted at $45.59; the earlier payment-review warning is no longer present.

items.name: STEPPERONLINE 17HE15-1504S · NEMA 17
items.notes: Two 1.5 A motors, 42×42×38 mm; 1 m cables included.

items.name: Zeelo GT2 · 5 m × 6 mm belt and pulleys
items.notes: Use two 20-tooth drive pulleys, 5 mm bore. Pack includes four. Cut the belt after checking the actual routing.

items.name: 3Dman · 10 smooth idlers · 5 mm bore
items.notes: For 6 mm belt. Measure actual height and adjust axial clearance with shims.

items.name: WINSINN · 5 toothed idlers · 5 mm bore
items.notes: Two installed. Listing variant and drawing specify 5 mm bore; measure the received parts.

items.name: SUNLU black PETG · 2 kg
items.notes: Initial FDM structural material; print fit coupons before the full set.

items.name: Plusivo S578 · soldering kit and multimeter
items.notes: Includes wiring tools, solder, flux, cutters, strippers and heat-shrink. 120 V input.

items.name: Kynup · 150 mm digital caliper
items.notes: For fit checks, screw measurements and spacer dimensions.

items.name: AMTOVL · 9 metric hex keys
items.notes: Includes 2.5, 3 and 4 mm sizes. The original camera mount imperial key set is not needed.

items.name: Anker Nano Pro · 20 W USB-C charger
items.notes: Separate charging for the phone.

items.name: Anker · USB-C to Lightning cable · 3 ft
items.notes: For iPhone 14; avoids relying on the refurbished phone's generic cable.

items.name: Airlonv · 17-inch LED desk lamp
items.notes: Adjust uniform lighting to limit screen reflections.

items.name: NEEWER UA057 · 22-inch camera arm
items.notes: 1/4-inch thread, stated 500 g capacity. Replaces the original mast, bracket and imperial fasteners.

items.name: Fermerry · 22 AWG silicone wire
items.notes: Six colors × 10 ft. For coil and signals; includes heat-shrink and cable ties.

items.name: ALITOVE · 12 V / 5 A / 60 W supply
items.notes: Machine supply; Raspberry Pi has its own supply. Center positive: verify polarity before connection.

items.name: uxcell · 150 mm X rail with MGN9H carriage
items.notes: Long H carriage; nominal assembled height 10 mm. Do not substitute MGN9C or MGN12.

items.name: BIGTREETECH TMC2209 V1.3 · pack of 2
items.notes: Two drivers and heatsinks. Do not duplicate the order at BIQU.

items.name: uxcell · two 250 mm Y rails with MGN9H carriages
items.notes: Pack includes two rails and carriages. Requires the specified 355 mm long frame profiles.

items.name: uxcell · 20 shims · 5×8×0.5 mm
items.notes: 20 pieces at 0.5 mm; combine with 12 from the assortment for 32 nominal pieces. ID 5 / OD 8 mm.

items.name: USDRWAM · 50 M3 square nuts
items.notes: 17 of 50 installed; 33 spare. M3, 5.4×5.4×2.4 mm. Captive in PETG, not T-slot nuts.

items.name: USDRWAM · 30 M5 square nuts
items.notes: 2 of 30 installed; 28 spare. M5, 8×8×4 mm. Captive in PETG, not RN05BM5.

items.name: uxcell · 50 M4 square nuts
items.notes: 10 of 50 installed; 40 spare. M4, 7×7×3 mm. Captive axle nuts, not GS20 frame nuts.

items.name: 48 shims · 5×8 mm · four thicknesses
items.notes: 48-piece set: 12 each at 0.1/0.2/0.3/0.5 mm. Use 12×0.5 + 12×0.3 + 2×0.2 with the other pack; remaining shims allow adjustment.

items.name: uxcell · 6 shoulder screws · Ø5×10 mm · M4
items.notes: 4 of 6 installed; 2 spare. Ø5×10 mm shoulder, M4×0.7 thread 8 mm long. Shorten only the two XY-joint threaded tips to 7.2–7.5 mm.

items.name: MECCANIXITY · 26 shoulder screws · Ø5×20 mm · M4
items.notes: 6 of 26 installed. Ø5×20 mm shoulder, M4×0.7 thread 8 mm long. Shorten only the two XY-joint threaded tips to 7.2–7.5 mm.

items.name: IRWIN 226303 · 3-inch clamp-on vise
items.notes: Holds the four threaded tips during preparation. Requires a compatible clamping surface.

items.name: Crescent Nicholson 21908N · 8-inch file
items.notes: Coarse/fine sides. File threaded tips and deburr; protect the smooth shoulder.

items.name: Century 4082 · file handle and 7 inserts
items.notes: Handle for the selected file.

items.name: BESSEY BV-NVJ · soft vise jaws
items.notes: Protects parts held in the vise.

items.name: Loctite 243 · 10 ml · 1329837
items.notes: Medium-strength blue threadlocker for metal-to-metal pulley set screws. Do not apply to PETG. One-time purchase, no subscription.

items.name: Micro Traders · 8 capacitive mesh tips · 7 mm
items.notes: One installed and seven spare. Collar Ø8.9×4.5 mm; M5 stem about 4.9 mm long. Printed clamp holds the collar; thread pitch is not assumed.

items.name: Crescent AC26VS · 6-inch adjustable wrench
items.notes: For NKK S301 panel mounting nuts; hex keys cannot perform this task.

items.name: Landtek MILA34300N · dual-channel contact thermometer
items.notes: Listing includes two K-type bead probes, two rigid probes and three AAA batteries. For commissioning checks on solenoid, motors and mounts.

items.name: Bambu Lab X2D AMS Combo · AMS2Pro
items.notes: Printer plus AMS2Pro combo, not two separate purchases.

items.notes: Millimeters; 355 mm; no machining.

items.notes: Millimeters; 190 mm; no machining.

items.notes: Millimeters; 185 mm; moving X beam.

items.notes: Millimeters; 190 mm; bed crossmembers.

items.name: GS20-05W · complete bracket kit
items.notes: 8 brackets + 16 M4×8 screws + 16 M4 slot-5 nuts.

items.name: RN05BM5 · M5, slot 5

items.name: DLC32 V2.1 · 1169-0401

changes.title: Grouped costs updated
changes.detail: Taxes, tariffs, shipping and others are grouped by store. These amounts are already included in order totals. Speedy charges are tracked separately in colones.

changes.title: Forwarder charges now tracked
changes.detail: Speedy shows ₡67,500 in charges across two exactly matched received shipments. This is a snapshot of amounts displayed to pay, not a confirmed payment or final consolidated total. Amounts are kept in colones, separate from the USD purchase totals.

changes.title: Owner confirms payment of shipped purchases
changes.detail: The owner confirmed that shipped purchases have been paid. Documented order totals for shipped orders are included in the paid subtotal, attributed to the owner rather than to a bank audit. A partially shipped order is excluded from the monetary subtotal until its shipped amounts can be allocated reliably. Delivery and forwarder receipt remain separate.

changes.title: Carrier delivery reported
changes.detail: Amazon reports the frame joining plates delivered to reception. The package is prealerted and consolidated; Speedy receipt remains unconfirmed.

changes.title: Frame shipment and receipt updates
changes.detail: FramingTech issued its paid invoice and UPS tracking. UPS estimates October 30 arrival; the shipment is prealerted and consolidated. Speedy lists another Amazon shipment received. Walmart reports another shipment delivered; Speedy receipt remains unconfirmed.

changes.title: Walmart package shipped
changes.detail: Walmart supplied USPS tracking for the spacer shipment. The package was prealerted and added to the second project consolidation. November 9 is the vendor delivery estimate.

changes.title: Joining plates shipped
changes.detail: Amazon provided tracking for the joining plates. The package was prealerted and added to the second project consolidation. Delivery on October 28 is estimated.

changes.title: Two carrier deliveries reported
changes.detail: Two further project shipments show delivered in Amazon tracking. Speedy receipt remains unconfirmed for both; carrier delivery and forwarder receipt are recorded separately.

changes.title: Another shipment joins the second consolidation
changes.detail: A separate project equipment shipment has UPS tracking. UPS reports acceptance and estimates October 30 delivery. The shipment was prealerted and added to the second project consolidation; the date is an estimate, not confirmed receipt.

changes.title: More shipments and a second consolidation
changes.detail: BoltDepot and PhotonLight sent USPS tracking. Both packages were prealerted and placed in a second project consolidation after the first reached ten packages. USPS reports the BoltDepot label created and awaiting the parcel. Speedy’s package listing shows one earlier Amazon shipment received; the consolidation view has not yet reflected receipt.

changes.title: Frame plates ordered
changes.detail: AMZ-06 adds one pack of flat joining plates: $9.99 less $0.50 coupon plus $0.66 estimated tax, for an order total of $10.15. Estimated delivery October 28; payment and tracking are not yet independently confirmed.

changes.title: Printer order and shipment tracking updated
changes.detail: Bambu Lab confirmed an $881.86 order, including $6.99 shipping, $57.69 tax and a $30.00 printer coupon. Taxes, tariffs, shipping and others are grouped and included in the order total. The first project consolidation now contains ten prealerted packages. Amazon reports one delivery to reception; forwarder receipt had not yet been confirmed at that time. Printed parts and physical tests remain ahead.

changes.title: Two forwarder prealerts consolidated; West3D payment documented
changes.detail: Two confirmed Amazon/FedEx packages are prealerted and grouped in the project consolidation. At the time, no package had a confirmed locker arrival. The original West3D invoice explicitly records $17.55 paid and $0.00 due, increasing documented vendor payments from $304.85 to $322.40; this remains a partial record, not complete bank reconciliation. Original PDFs and identifiers stay private.

changes.title: Private dispatch room and new order confirmations
changes.detail: VXB ($65.22), West3D ($17.55) and PhotonLight ($18.94) are confirmed by vendor emails, with fees recorded separately. Amazon no longer displays the earlier payment-review warnings. The private dispatch room tracks original invoices, full tracking numbers and locker arrivals; those records are excluded from the public ledger. No settled bank payments or arrivals are inferred.

changes.title: Walmart order confirmed
changes.detail: Walmart confirmed an order totaling $53.31, including the grouped category already reflected in the order total. No dispatch or settled bank charge was confirmed at that time.

changes.title: BoltDepot order confirmed with owner-selected spares
changes.detail: The vendor confirmed 13 references and 182 pieces, including the extra spares requested by the owner. Items total $16.04, shipping $8.41 and sales tax $1.71; order total $26.16. The original 99-piece quote was $8.22. The additional $7.82 in parts increases the equipment estimate from $2,885.87 to $2,893.69; the $500 allowance is unchanged. No shipment or settled bank charge is confirmed.

changes.title: DigiKey order confirmed
changes.detail: DigiKey confirmed 11 purchase units totaling $96.97: $77.36 items, $8.49 shipping, $5.79 sales tax and $5.33 tariff. Two vendor sales orders are processing. No shipment or settled bank charge is confirmed, so verified payments remain unchanged.

changes.title: Purchases resumed
changes.detail: The project owner resumed purchases one store at a time. The DigiKey cart was rechecked: 11 references, $77.36 in items and $91.18 estimated including shipping and tariff. The Remington wire lists approximately 8 days to dispatch and may incur a separate shipping fee. No new order or payment is confirmed by this update.

changes.title: Equipment estimate increased by $500
changes.detail: At the project owner’s request, a $500.00 unallocated equipment allowance increases the equipment estimate from $2,385.87 to $2,885.87. The 74 item quotes and vendor subtotals are unchanged. This is a planning adjustment, not an order, expense or payment.

changes.title: Grouped category recorded
changes.detail: The grouped category was recorded within Amazon order totals; no new expense or payment was created.

changes.title: Reconciled with email and Amazon
changes.detail: $300.66 paid to FramingTech. GoDaddy confirms $4.19 for the domain. Amazon listed five orders totaling $1,524.35; grouped charges were already included in the order totals.

changes.title: Purchases paused to open the journal
changes.detail: Publishing the plan, procurement data and prototype files. No new purchase is confirmed during this pause.

changes.title: Adafruit items moved to DigiKey
changes.detail: Adafruit rejects forwarding/mailbox addresses. References 412, 5648, 3893 and 4873 remain unchanged. Qualtek 3021001-03 replaces Adafruit USB cable 62. DigiKey item subtotal changes from $61.45 to $77.36. The five-item group changes from $17.60 to $15.91, before shipping and tax.

changes.title: Camera quote updated
changes.detail: EMEET C960 4K changed from $43.31 to $45.59 before the Amazon order: +$2.28. Cart subtotals are not presented as final charges.

changes.title: Initial owner confirmation
changes.detail: The owner initially reported Amazon and FramingTech complete. The later evidence review distinguishes confirmed payment from order creation and payment issues.

changes.title: Architecture and parts selected
changes.detail: CoreXY prototype derived from PhysiClaw hardware v0.51, with PETG adaptations. Motor brackets and feet will be printed; two metal reinforcements remain in the parts list.

changes.title: Joining plates ordered
changes.detail: The joining plate quote was replaced by the confirmed Amazon order; thickness and fit remain to be checked when the parts arrive.
